newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Oct 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Chinese newspapers - Oct 8.

text.p: Following is a summary of major Chinese political and business stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Beijing. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (8610) 6532-1921. Fax: (8610) 6532-4978.
In a speech to the 47th International Astronautical Congress, President Jiang Zemin says China will make greater contributions to the peaceful utilisation of space resources.
China and Britain sign an agreement paving the way for Chinese companies to list on the London Stock Exchange.
China's vice-premier Jiang Chunyun says China can feed its 1.2 billion people by itself and does not pose a threat to world grain and food security.
A senior tax analyst calls for expansion of consumption taxes to cover such items as gourmet food, clothing, electric appliances and cosmetics.
A front-page editorial urges more efforts in nurturing China's fledgling stock markets, saying funds raised through the markets is still too low.
The China Securities Regulatory Commission will publish the latest edition of its white paper on the securities market.
A commentary urges the Chinese government to adopt various measures to boost financial revenues.
